title: Both driving models detected the other vehicle before most simulated collisions
summary: On the NeuroNCAP simulator, object tracking met the study’s detection criterion before 95.9% of DiffusionDrive’s collisions and 95.8% of SparseDrive’s collisions. The audit distinguished missed actors from collision episodes in which the learned detection system had tracked the actor.
ai_technology: DiffusionDrive and SparseDrive, learned vehicle detection and planning

evidence.tested: The authors separated stock-model simulation episodes by collision outcome and by whether vehicle tracking met a prespecified analysis criterion.
evidence.unknown: The result depends on the simulator, models and tracking definition. The presence of a detection does not identify the cause of an individual crash or establish road performance.
evidence.ai_role: The learned perception systems provided the actor tracks compared with closed-loop simulation outcomes.
